final.role: Tokenization, tagging, lemmatization and dependency parsing of text; could feed lemma-based indexing.
final.evidence: "trainable pipeline for tokenization, tagging, lemmatization and dependency parsing"; "binary for Linux/Windows/OS X"; models for nearly all UD treebanks

auditoria.nota: Windows-ready lemmatizer that could normalize Portuguese terms for lexical search; its trained models are non-commercial (CC BY-NC-SA).
